integrity: The proof reconstructs subspace inclusion directly from neighborhood inclusion, applies the fundamental theorem of projective geometry, and derives the rank-three spectrum from the exact point-plane incidence identities of PG(2,p). The packaged checker independently reconstructs the rank-three graphs for p=2,3,5 and verifies the structural matrix identities.
scientific_limitations: The graph-automorphism theorem concerns elementary-abelian groups of rank at least three.
The exact characteristic polynomial is proved only in rank three.
The rank-two boundary has a larger symmetric automorphism group.
The result does not classify all nonisomorphic finite groups sharing these join graphs.
title: Projective rigidity and the rank-three spectrum of elementary-abelian join graphs
